title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover ordering
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Context: Following an incident on 2026-02-18 where regional failover + SLO enforcer backoff caused request ordering thrashing across clusters, this hotfix stabilizes the SLO enforcer backoff smoothing and enforces deterministic ordering during regional failover. Motivation: Reduce cascading circuit-breaker flips and avoid request re-ordering that caused elevated tail latency and increased error budgets. Summary of changes: 1) Tighter backoff smoothing window for SLO enforcer state transitions (reduce oscillation). 2) Deterministic regional failover ordering: failover coordinator now serializes failover steps and plays a short jittered delay before promoting next region. 3) Lock-free guard for per-customer enqueue ordering to avoid head-of-line reordering during bursty failover. 4) Add metrics and tracing spans for transition events and backoff state to aid future RCA. Checklists: - [x] Updated SLO enforcer algorithm with smoothing constants and explanatory comments - [x] Added unit tests for backoff smoothing and ordering invariants - [x] Added integration test that simulates regional failover with bursty loads - [x] Added observability dashboards and new metric names (slo_enforcer.backoff_state, failover.coordinator.step) - [x] Verified no behavioral change for normal, non-failover paths Rollback plan: revert hotfix branch and immediately re-deploy previous main; gating for rollback includes observed >2x error-budget burn or sustained latency SLO violations for >5 minutes after deploy. Related: ENG-4082 discussion thread: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4082/stabilize-slo-enforcer-backoff and incident SUP-2308 notes. Notes: This is intentionally conservative (smoothing only, ordering serialization with short jitter) to avoid introducing new performance regressions.
commits: 3 commits: a) stabilize: tune backoff smoothing window + comments (Priya) b) fix: deterministic failover coordinator ordering + test (Priya) c) add: metrics/tracing for SLO transitions + dashboards (Priya)
review_comments: Alex Kim (reviewer): LGTM overall; main concern is the serialized failover ordering potentially adding latency to failovers — please add a microbenchmark and justify the chosen jitter window.
Priya Natarajan (author): Added a microbenchmark and tuned jitter to 50-150ms based on our simulated failover test. Benchmarks are included in commits and results are in the PR description.

Mateo Ruiz (reviewer): Unit tests look good. Integration simulation reproduced previous thrashing in the pre-fix branch and shows stable behavior post-fix. Recommended to roll out canary to 10% of traffic first.
Samantha Lee (reviewer): Approved after CI fixed a flaky e2e that required a small timeout increase; confirmed metrics names and dashboards.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff smoothing and add deterministic regional failover ordering to prevent circuit-breaker thrashing and request re-ordering during regional failovers. Includes metrics and dashboards for faster RCA.
notes: Deployed 2026-02-22 04:30 UTC to prod. Monitoring for 60m passed; follow-up to observe for 48h. Ops pager on-call will review any regressions.
